title: Vole Baskets in Stainless Steel Mesh 15-Pack – Protection Around the Roots
seo_title: Vole Baskets 15-Pack in Stainless Steel Mesh – Protection for the Roots
seo_description: 15 baskets in stainless steel mesh, mixed sizes. Placed in the planting hole around the root ball so the vole can't get at the roots.
descriptionHtml:
The bulb is eaten from below before you see that anything is wrong

You plant tulip bulbs or a new shrub in the fall, and by spring the root is gone – eaten from below without you having seen a trace above ground. The damage only shows when the plant doesn't come up.

15 baskets in stainless steel mesh around each root ball

The basket is placed in the planting hole, around the root ball, and the plant is planted in the basket. The stainless steel mesh keeps the vole away from the roots. 15 baskets in mixed sizes come in the same pack, for bulbs and shrubs of different sizes.

Features

  • 15 baskets in the pack – mixed sizes, one for each bulb or shrub
  • The vole can't get at the roots – the basket goes into the planting hole around the root ball
  • The mesh is stainless steel – doesn't rust in the soil
  • The plant goes straight into the basket – no extra moving of the plant afterwards

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
